summary: Runway's startup program for Seed to Series C companies: up to 500k free API credits, Tier 5 (highest) API rate limits, access to the Runway Characters conversational avatar API, and a private builders community with Slack access, training and direct support.
claim_steps: Open https://runway.com/product/builders and fill in the application form (company, funding stage, use case).
Eligibility: Seed through Series C startups (incl. Pre-Seed and Bootstrapped options on the form).
Questions can be sent to runway-builders@runwayml.com.

social_proof.title: Runway Builders Program — Startups building with Runway start here
social_proof.text: The Runway Builders Program gives Seed to Series C startups complementary API credits. ... Up to 500k free API credits to start building immediately. Unlock Tier 5 access — Runway's highest API usage tier.
